_comment: WHICH ONE DO I USE? Developing a capability against your LOCAL corpus -> these servers (mcp__local-dev-*__*). ANYTHING ABOUT PRODUCTION -> the claude.ai connector mcp__claude_ai_Close_Listening__* (https://mcp.closelistening.app/mcp), already in your tool list, no setup. THE TELL YOU PICKED WRONG IS AN EMPTY ANSWER: these reply `feeds: []` / `not_found` / `ImportError` for a prod entity, which is shaped exactly like a finding and is not one — on 2026-09-24 an agent asked these whether a repaired prod episode existed, got not_found, and nearly reported the repair as failed. Renamed from `podcast-content` / `podcast-observability` because those names were indistinguishable from the prod connectors at the point of use. Run `make serve` first or the content server answers about an empty corpus. Both stdio (local trust, no auth). Rule: AGENTS.md section 'MCP servers - PROD vs DEV'. Claude Desktop/Cursor: docs/guides/LOCAL_MCP_SERVERS.md.
